goal: Arkham playable from the base by the official 7e guide «Arkham» (Chaosium, 2023): the city overview, investigators and miscellany, the directory and every neighborhood with its numbered places, people, maps and floorplans, the outskirts and appendices (Р-234); the fan guide by Hort (from Arkham Unveiled) adds what the 2023 book lacks.
extra:
## This work (Р-234)

Source: `arkham-en` (the English 7e book, edition original; printed page = physical − 1, `offset` set). Russian text: our translation (flag `translated`). A machine translation of the same book (same page layout) is at `.cache/mt/arkham-ru-ai.txt` (pages split by form feed; page N of the file = physical page N) — it is NOT a source (Р-147): use it only as a draft, check every sentence against the English, never take a number or a name from it unchecked; official Russian names of the base and the glossary (`kb/terms/`) win; cite only `arkham-en`. Maps and floorplans: `arkham-insert-maps-en` (city maps), `arkham-maps-en` (keeper floorplans, 34 pp.), `arkham-advertiser-en` (newspaper handout).

- **Places are shared** (the city guide is the canon of Arkham): `coc:location:<slug>` in `kb/locations/` with `number` = the book's number (100–999, OS100–OS199) and `part_of` = the neighborhood record (`coc:location:arkham-<neighborhood>`, type район, `part_of` coc:location:arkham; the outskirts under `coc:location:arkham-environs`). Before creating a place Grep `kb/` (Russian and English names): shared Arkham records exist (arkham, arkham-environs, miskatonic-university, orne-library, arkham-sanitarium, arkham-gazette/advertiser, St Mary's Hospital, etc.) — change them only through proposals (`checks/20261114-arkham/proposals-<unit>.json`); book-scoped Arkham places of other books (e.g. `keepers-companion-en/location/arkham-*`, `kanikuly-v-innsmute-ru`…) are NOT edited — list them in your coverage file under «Кандидаты на слияние (Р-154)» with the shared id they match.
- **People** of the guide: book records `arkham-en/character/<slug>` (statblocks as printed, Р-25; `residents`/`based_at` links to the shared places); if a shared `coc:character:*` exists (Armitage and others) — link and propose, do not duplicate.
- Organizations, items, tomes, rules (investigator options, reputation, getting around, experts, weapons, pulp Arkham, rumours) as usual: rules and tables shared `coc:rule:arkham-*` / `coc:table:arkham-*`, organizations and items of the book `arkham-en/<kind>/<slug>`.
- Maps: `map` records `arkham-en/map/<unit>-<slug>` with the image `app/maps/arkham-<unit>-<slug>.jpg` (from the insert maps or floorplans PDFs, at least 150 dpi) and spots on every printed number/label (Р-206), checked by eye on an overlay. Each unit takes the floorplans of its own buildings.
- Dice with lowercase d (Р-27), metric units (Р-64; street addresses and names keep their form), `axes.era` ["1920s"], ruleset "core". Keep scratch files in `.cache/<unit>/`, never in the repo root. Coverage: `checks/20261114-arkham/<unit>.md` — every heading → record(s), «Не взято», «Кандидаты на слияние (Р-154)»; no git.
